Millbrook’s growth from 2020 to 2025 was:

\[
\frac{37,203-34,590}{34,590}\times100 \approx 7.554\%
\]

Applying the same percentage growth to the 2025 population:

\[
37,203 \times \frac{37,203}{34,590} \approx 40,011.6
\]

This exceeds 40,000 residents. Rounded to 0 decimal places, the projection is 40,012.

ANSWER: yes | 40012

Millbrook’s population increased from 34,590 to 37,203, a factor of \(37,203 / 34,590\). Applying the same percentage growth to 2025–2030:

\(37,203 \times (37,203 / 34,590) \approx 40,016\).

Thus, it would exceed 40,000 residents.

ANSWER: yes | 40016
